results.hypothesis:
Changed only `src/index.ts`: removed full-oplog allocation and sentinel fills for both lookup arrays in checkout and incremental merge.

Invariant: each lookup slot is written when its operation is first applied, before advance/retreat reads it. Sentinel values are unused.

Hypothesis: less initialization and memory use, especially for small incremental merges. Risk: sparse-array growth may offset gains.

`git diff --check` passed. Correctness and benchmarks remain for the parent.
reasons: gain did not repeat in every paired round

results.hypothesis:
Changed only `src/index.ts`: checkout now builds its snapshot once from final CRDT items, eliminating per-operation snapshot splices.

Invariant: items already encode final order and visibility; surviving items reference their original generic payloads. Incremental merges and public APIs are unchanged.

Hypothesis: fewer repeated array shifts. Risk: the final scan may offset gains for append-only histories. `git diff --check` passed; correctness and benchmarks remain for the parent.

Changed only `src/index.ts`: removed a repeated linear search for an insert’s right boundary by passing its already-known index to `integrate`.

Invariant: the item list is unchanged between boundary discovery and integration. Public API and ordering logic remain unchanged.

Hypothesis: less scanning during concurrent inserts. Risk: the extra argument and boundary lookup may offset gains elsewhere.

`git diff --check` passed. Correctness and benchmarks remain for the parent.
reasons: gain did not repeat in every paired round

reasons: gain did not repeat in every paired round

review.invariant: Sentinel fills are not consumed by valid traversal; every read follows an assignment. Sparse-array growth changes representation and can cost more than removed initialization.
review.verdict: Semantically plausible and tests pass; empirically rejected for performance.

review.invariant: For checkout only, snapshot is exactly the ctx.items sequence filtered by endState===Inserted and mapped to original insertion payloads; advance/retreat alter curState only, and snapshot is never read during replay. Incremental merges must retain their existing snapshot mutations.
review.verdict: Source invariant independently reviewed and tests pass; empirically rejected by per-workload guards. Do not treat overall gain as admitted.

review.invariant: The right boundary index is captured before any mutation to ctx.items; deriving its stored operation ID and passing the index to integrate preserves the same boundary.
review.verdict: Tests pass; rejected because corpus gain is below 3% and not positive in every paired round.

priorWinnerProof.reasonNoRepeat: Retained source is byte-identical to the already certified prior winner; no new winner requires holdout or full-trace certification.

limitations: Correctness passed development checks, not a full CRDT proof. Rejected candidates were not run through holdout or full bundled traces.
Shared-host timing and sub-millisecond workloads can be noisy; policy was not relaxed and no discarded source was remeasured to seek a favourable result.
Setup is outside the timer but changes can still affect later runtime/JIT state. The cause of proposal 2 merge regressions is not established.
Independent parent draft 9205d4a duplicated proposal 2 and was not evaluated or retained.
Prompts and native model transcripts are excluded from publication; raw verifier outputs, native own-exit metadata and candidate patches are preserved.
